result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but one element looks visually broken: in the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a white circular loading spinner overlaying the center of the restaurant image, indicating the image/content failed to finish loading while every other card renders fully. All other partially visible elements (carousel clipping at the right edge, card cut off at the bottom) are expected behaviors and not defects.

issues.description: The first card in 'Popular right now' (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) displays a persistent white circular loading spinner centered on top of the restaurant photo, making the card look stuck/broken even though the image behind it appears loaded.
issues.suggestion: Remove the loading spinner once the card image/content has loaded; ensure the spinner is hidden on successful load and only shown during actual loading, with an error/retry state if loading fails.

issues.description: The loading spinner's white circle overlaps and obscures the center of the ramen dish image, reducing the visual appeal of the featured card even if loading were intentional.
issues.suggestion: If a loading indicator is needed, use a smaller, semi-transparent indicator or a skeleton placeholder for the whole image instead of an opaque white circle over the finished artwork.
